authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 7067 nāman explicitly gives Kalasha nom, northern nam and western/eastern nāũ “name”. These ordinary phonetic and case forms fit the name paradigm. No Khowar Persian-versus-Indic ambiguity is resolved by this pass. Reviewed comparator: Brj nām “name” (f_nhjyspgaqnp2s). Any uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages remains open under the user’s preference; source phonetic details are preserved.
